weakness: Braid-specific validator evidence was hidden inside unrelated broad workflow failures.
hypothesis: A path-scoped, serialized workflow that runs only npm run test:braid will reduce time-to-diagnosis and prevent unrelated application failures from being mistaken for braid-validator failure.
evaluation_window: next 3 pull-request revisions touching braid paths
adoption_gate: Braid Control Plane check reports an independent conclusion
npm run test:braid command is visible in the hosted job
superseded runs for the same pull request are cancelled
risks: npm ci can fail before the braid tests if the lockfile is inconsistent
path filters can omit a future braid dependency unless maintained
workflow serialization does not replace repository lease validation
rollback: Delete .github/workflows/braid-control-plane.yml; retain the experiment and test fixtures as decision history.
